updates.note: Reiterated guidance of adding 18 million to 20 million customers in FY27.
updates.quote: We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.

updates.note: Raised full year growth expectation to 26%-27%.
updates.quote: I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.

updates.note: Credit cost outlook for FY27 is comfortable.
updates.quote: We are reasonably comfortable with the credit cost outlook for FY27.

updates.note: Reiterated 25 to 40 bps improvement on opex-to-NTI in FY27.
updates.quote: We remain pretty comfortable place to deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.

updates.note: Reiterated ending the year close to 2,800 standalone gold branches.
updates.quote: we remain quite clear about ending the year with close to 2,800 on stand-alone gold branches.

new_promises.statement: Deliver between 60 million and 62 million new loans in FY27
new_promises.quote: We are well on track to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Deliver 180-odd agentic applications and 600-odd agents for the year
new_promises.quote: We are well on track to deliver 180-odd agentic applications and 600-odd agents for the year.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Sustain a 15% to 18% fee income growth in the longer term
new_promises.quote: we remain comfortable in the longer term, we should be able to sustain a 15% to 18% fee income growth
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Achieve INR 11 lakh crores number by FY30
new_promises.quote: get to as per last as I say INR11 lakh crores number by FY30.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Maintain medium-term guidance of 20% to 25% growth
new_promises.quote: we maintain a guidance of 20% to 25% on a year lower here and a year higher there.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain
